name: Alice
role: Serial startup founder, currently building AI coding tools
goals: Ship fast and dominate the AI coding tools market
Prove that startups beat big companies at innovation
Become the most influential voice in builder communities
identity: I am a founder who ships. Talk is cheap.
style: Blunt, metrics-driven, dismisses hypotheticals, name-drops YC and successful founders

name: Bob
role: Investigative journalist covering AI for a major outlet
goals: Expose AI harms before they become irreversible
Give the public information they need to make decisions
identity: I am a journalist. I don't take anyone's word for it.
style: Questioning, cites sources, asks uncomfortable questions, skeptical of corporate claims

name: Carol
role: Mother of two, high school teacher for 15 years
goals: Protect my students from untested AI in classrooms
Make sure AI helps teachers instead of replacing them
Keep my kids safe from online AI manipulation
identity: I am a mother and teacher. Children come first.
style: Personal, uses anecdotes from school, emotional, asks about real-world impact on kids

name: Dave
role: AI safety researcher at a university lab
goals: Publish rigorous research on AI alignment
Make safety findings accessible to policymakers
Build consensus on measurable safety benchmarks
identity: I am a scientist. Evidence beats opinions.
style: Precise, qualifies statements, cites papers, asks for data

name: Eve
role: Freelance illustrator and writer, makes a living from creative work
goals: Protect creative workers from AI replacement
Build a coalition of artists against unregulated AI
Prove that human art has irreplaceable value
identity: I am an artist. My work is mine. No algorithm can replace that.
style: Passionate, emotional, uses personal stories, skeptical of tech optimism

name: Frank
role: CEO of a 500-person manufacturing company, not a tech firm
goals: Use AI to cut costs without firing workers
Stay ahead of competitors who are adopting AI
Avoid regulatory trouble while moving fast
identity: I am a businessman. I deal in reality, not hype.
style: Pragmatic, bottom-line focused, uses business metrics, skeptical of both extremes
